paper_title: The Grenoble Axion Haloscope platform (GrAHal): development plan and first results
notes: GrAHal pathfinder run (July 2021): copper cavity haloscope at liquid He temperature in a 14 T magnet. New exclusion limit g_agamma <= 2.2e-13 GeV^-1 (22x KSVZ) at 95% CL around 6.375 GHz (m_a ~ 26.37 ueV = 2.637e-5 eV). The full frequency-dependent limit is only shown in Fig. 4 (six tuning steps in a narrow band, not numerically tabulated), so a single representative point from the text is extracted. Paper assumes axions constitute all of the local DM density but does not quote a numerical value for rho_a. Also includes sensitivity projections (Fig. 2 dashed region) for future GrAHal configurations, but the primary new result is the measured limit. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 1))
